def f(inputs: List[Tuple[int, str, str, str]]):
    from typing import List, Tuple
    results = []
    for x, s, t, b in inputs:
        s, t, b = s.lower(), t.lower(), b.lower()
        if s == t:
            continue
        if s == b:
            n_s = ord(s) // x
            n_t = ord(t) // x
            results.append(abs(n_s - n_t))
        elif t == b:
            n_s = ord(s) // x
            n_b = ord(b) // x
            results.append(abs(n_s - n_b))
        else:
            n_s = ord(s) // x
            n_t = ord(t) // x
            n_b = ord(b) // x
            results.append(max(abs(n_s - n_t), abs(n_s - n_b), abs(n_t - n_b)))
    return results
